title: Modal
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). It must have a button that opens a modal dialog with a title, a paragraph of text, a close button in the corner, and Cancel/Save buttons in the footer.

title: Card grid
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Show a responsive grid of 6 product cards: 1 column on phones, 2 on tablets, 3 on desktop. Each card has an image, a title, a short description and a button. All cards in a row must be the same height.

title: Navbar + offcanvas
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). It needs a sticky top navigation bar with a logo on the left, 4 links plus one dropdown menu in the centre, a search icon on the right, and on mobile a hamburger button that opens an off-canvas side menu.

title: Hero
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a full-viewport-height hero section with a background image, a dark overlay, centred white headline, subheadline and two call-to-action buttons.

title: Form
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a contact form with stacked labels: first name and last name side by side, email, a subject select, a message textarea, a checkbox for consent, and a submit button. Show one field in an error state with a help text.

title: Pricing
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a pricing section with three plans side by side; the middle plan must be visually highlighted with a dark/primary background and a badge. Each plan lists features with check icons and has a CTA button.

title: Tabs
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a tabbed interface with 3 tabs that switch between 3 content panels, plus an FAQ accordion below it with 4 questions where the first one is open.

title: Table
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a data table of users (avatar, name, email, role, status badge, actions) that is striped, hoverable, scrolls horizontally on small screens, and has pagination underneath.

title: Slideshow
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create an image slideshow with 3 slides, captions overlaid on each slide, previous/next arrows and dot navigation, that autoplays.

title: Article + sticky sidebar
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create a blog article layout: a two-column layout where the article takes 2/3 and a sidebar takes 1/3, the sidebar sticks while scrolling, and on mobile the sidebar goes below the article. Include article meta info and a comment.

title: Landing page
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Build a complete SaaS landing page: navbar, hero, a features section with icons, a testimonial section on a dark background, a logo/social-proof strip, a final call-to-action band and a footer with link columns.

title: Dashboard
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Build an admin dashboard shell: a fixed left sidebar navigation, a top bar with a user dropdown, a row of 4 KPI stat cards, and below them a wide panel and a narrow panel side by side.

title: Gallery + lightbox
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Create an image gallery grid where clicking an image opens it in a lightbox with captions and next/previous navigation. Images should have a hover overlay with a zoom icon.

title: Feedback UI
prompt: Build a single self-contained HTML page using the UIkit framework (getuikit.com). Demonstrate feedback elements: a dismissible success alert, a danger alert, a progress bar, a spinner, tooltips on three buttons, and a button that triggers a toast notification in the top-right corner.

title: Add modal to existing page
prompt:
Here is an existing page fragment that already uses UIkit:

Team

Ada

Engineer

Grace

Engineer

Add a 'Add member' button under the heading that opens a modal containing a small form (name, role, submit). Return only the modified fragment.
